lines.text: She heard.

lines.text: That's from earlier. Moon Dub.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Big up the crater crew.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Echo comes back in eleven seconds. We'll be in the next tune by then. It'll find us. Run it.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: The crater crew.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: There it is.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Told you it'd find us. Bass.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Low gravity tonight. Sixteen percent. Bass, four hundred percent. The dust doesn't know what to do with itself. Let it bounce.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Earth's coming up over the ridge. Look at her. Sleepy face. Big blue yawn.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: This one's for Earth.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Shout-out to the lone astronaut by the lander. Been nodding for three days. Same tune, different tune. Doesn't matter. He's nodding.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Grumbel's Ladders. Up here, you only need the first rung.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Up is a choice.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: A choice.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Quiet one coming up.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Put the kettle on.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Not from me. Somebody on Earth. Eleven seconds ago. Two hundred thousand miles. Go on, then. Put the kettle on.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Late on the moon. Stars don't twinkle up here. They just stare.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Respect. Here's a heavy one.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: People ask why I don't talk much.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Bass is talking.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Listen.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Shadow on the far side. Nobody attached. Says his name's Greg. Sound guy now. Good ears.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Hollis says come home. Greg says one more tune.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: One more tune.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Morning on the moon looks exactly like night on the moon. Only difference, I've had a coffee.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Selector's awake. Run it.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Dust from the last tune's still in the air. It'll come down next week. Leave it. It's part of the mix.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Afternoon. Speaker stack pointed at Earth. If you're down there and your teacup's rattling, that's us.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Sorry. Not sorry. Bass.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Evening. Earth's lights are coming on. Little cities. Little kitchens. Little radios. Hello, little radios.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Little radios.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Selector Crater. I've said a lot tonight. Too much, maybe.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Going to let the speakers do the rest. They're better at it. Here's a tune.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Something on the long-range set. Faint.

lines.speaker: Faint voice
lines.text: Can anyone hear me? This is Teodor. Relay Four.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: We hear you, Teodor. Moon hears you. Here's one for Relay Four.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Relay Four.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Big up everyone on the late shift.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Big up the crater crew.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: That's an old one. Still counts. Big up everyone.

lines.text: Earthrise Session. She's coming up over the ridge now.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Morning, Earth.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Earth's up. Big blue yawn. She's had a long night too.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: This one's soft. For her.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Every morning, somebody down there looks up and sees us.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: They don't know there's a sound system. They just think the moon looks happy.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: It is.

lines.text: Low Gravity Session.

lines.text: Late on the moon. Gravity's down to sixteen percent. Bass is up to the ceiling.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: There is no ceiling. Let it go up.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Shout-out to the lone astronaut. Still nodding. Day nine.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Somebody bring that man a sandwich.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Bring that man a sandwich.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Selector Crater. Still here.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Run it.

lines.text: Big tune.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: King Regolith sent a dubplate up from the crater floor. Took him three days to carry it. Low gravity. He kept floating off.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Worth it.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Dust from last week's big tune is still coming down. Slowly. Like snow that's thinking about it.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Leave it. It's part of the mix.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Big up Earth.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: That's from Tuesday.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Still true. Big up Earth.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Some things don't need to come back on time.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Big Bass Selene on the stack tonight. Every time the bass drops, the lander bounces.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Insurance is not happy.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: People ask what I do between tunes.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: I look at the Earth.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: That's it. That's the job.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Run it.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Run it.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Bass.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Here. Hold tight.

lines.text: Next tune. Heavy one. Mind the dust.

clips.title: Greg Comes Home, Part Three: A Ride on the Moonlight

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Shadow came down off a comet this morning. Landed soft. Low gravity.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Greg. Back again. Sound guy.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Just passing through. I'm going home.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Respect.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: I'm very sharp up here.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: No air. Nothing to blur you. Sharpest you'll ever be.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Can I send a message? To Hollis? On the echo?

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Say it into the stack. It'll go down to Earth, and come back. Eleven seconds.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Hollis. It's me. I'm coming home.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: How do I get down from here? There's no ladder long enough.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Grumbel's would disagree.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: No. You go the old way. Moonlight. Every night the moon throws light down to Earth. Shadows have been riding it forever. Nobody checks tickets.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: Where does it land?

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Tonight? Precinct Nine. One gap in the clouds all year, and it's tonight. That's luck.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Coming home.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: There it is. Echo came back.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Earth heard you, Greg.

lines.speaker: Greg, a Shadow
lines.text: One more tune before I go?

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: One more tune.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: One more tune.

clips.title: Teodor Is Heard, Part Three: The Moon Says Yes

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Long-range set. Faint.

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: Is anyone receiving this. This is Relay Four.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Moon hears you, Teodor. Always has.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: But his receiver's broke. News said so. He talks out. Nothing comes in.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: So. Turn the stack round. Point it at the edge of the dial. All of it.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Bass travels. Bass goes through walls. Bass goes through broken things.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Everybody on the crater. On three. One. Two.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Eleven seconds. Wait for it.

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: Relay Four. Night four thousand and nine. Something strange. Just now I heard a voice. Very deep. Very far away.

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: It said yes.

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: Either that was the moon, or I'm coming down with something.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: That was the moon, Teodor.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: The moon.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Boo.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: That's from last Halloween.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Took the long way round. Still works.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Moon Dub. Full moon. Halloween.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Big night for us.

clips.title: The Convergence: A Moon Goes Missing

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Word on the dial. A moon gone missing.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Not this one. I'm standing on it.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Standing on it.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Smell of toast. Everywhere. Even up here.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: No air on the moon. Still smell it. Heavy.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Heavy.

clips.title: The Convergence: The Song Nobody Can Finish

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Everybody's got the same tune. Nobody's got the end.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: So dub it. Take the end out. Nobody notices.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Nobody notices.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Three knocks on the airlock.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Nobody out there. Nobody's ever out there. Respect.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Respect.

clips.title: The Convergence: A Colour With No Name

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Earth just went a colour. Not blue. Not green. Something else.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Pointed the stack at it. Bass, four hundred percent. It went back to blue.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: A pigeon. On the moon. Walked in through the airlock.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Nodded at me like it knew the tune. Respect, pigeon.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Respect, pigeon.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Moon Dub Sound System. Full moon tonight.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: We're the full part.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: The full part.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Full moon down there means a dark Earth up here. Funny how it works.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: They get the light. We get the dark. Fair trade. Speakers out. Pointed down. Bass, all the way.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Full moon ritual. Turn every speaker to face the sun, one at a time. Say thank you for the light.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Turn them back round. Play the heaviest tune in the box. That's it. That's the ritual.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: That's the ritual.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Full moon. The tide's pulling on every ocean down there.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Some of that's us. Bass moves water. Surf's up in seven countries. You're welcome.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Lone astronaut's come out for the full moon. Still nodding. Day four hundred.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Brought his own sandwich this time.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Growth.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: Shout-out to everybody down there, looking up at the full moon, thinking it's quiet up here.

lines.speaker: Selector Crater
lines.text: It isn't. Wave. Hold tight.

lines.speaker: Echo
lines.text: Hold tight.
